systems.name: 1.1 Skill Tree & Character Builds
systems.notes: Replace fixed J/K/L skills with a Diablo‑style skill tree. Players unlock points on level‑up and can invest in multiple skill paths (melee, ranged, magic).
tasks: Design skill tree UI with tiered branches
Active skill unlocks gated by tree investment
Respec mechanism (cost or one‑time per act)

systems.name: 1.2 Enemy AI & Boss Design Overhaul
systems.notes: Diablo 1 enemies had distinct movement patterns, retaliation, and immunities. Upgrade current AI with pathfinding, fleeing, and unique boss mechanics.
tasks: Add enemy resistances and immunities per type
Boss phases with distinct attacks and arena hazards
Enemy fleeing and calling for help
Elite monster packs with affixes (extra fast, fire enchanted)

systems.name: 1.3 Loot & Itemization Depth
systems.notes: Already have inventory and rarity system. Expand with Diablo 1 affix pools, unique items, set items, and proper drop rates from boss loot tables.
tasks: Unique items with custom effects and lore text

systems.name: 1.4 Player Progression & Stats
systems.notes: Add character leveling, stat points (strength, dexterity, vitality, energy), and hit recovery / block mechanics.
tasks: XP and level‑up system with stat allocation
Hit recovery and block chance animations
